ideas.pitch: An AI-powered local waterlogging and drainage capacity forecasting tool tailored for municipal community planning, using Poisson regression and historical rainfall maps.
ideas.title: Community Flood & Drainage Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: It directly targets the Smart & Sustainable Future track by applying rigorous statistical forecasting to everyday climate resilience challenges.

ideas.pitch: An automated browser extension and API backend that uses graph intelligence and fine-tuned transformers to detect sophisticated spear-phishing campaigns targeting small businesses.
ideas.title: Phishing-Shield AI: Enterprise Email Social Engineering Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Digital Safety & Cybersecurity track with an actionable, enterprise-grade prevention mechanism that defends digital systems from modern threats.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition platform that generates hyper-personalized meal plans and regional dietary substitutes for communities with limited access to standard healthcare nutritional advice.
ideas.title: AuraDiet: Culturally Adaptive Nutrition Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Inclusive Technology track by focusing on accessible health guidance and localized dietary education.

ideas.pitch: An everyday routing app that computes real-time carbon footprints for micro-journeys using public transit, walking, and micro-mobility, incentivizing sustainable habits for individuals.
ideas.title: EcoRoute: Carbon-Optimized Local Commute Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the AI for Everyday Life problem statement by solving a practical sustainability challenge faced by daily commuters.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision web application that uses real-time hand-tracking models to verify correct sign language grammar for students, bridging communication gaps in educational settings.
ideas.title: SignBridge: Interactive Sign Language Learning & Verification Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines difficult computer vision engineering with the Inclusive Technology track's core focus on accessibility and education.
